overview_description.description: NearSync is an all-in-one workspace that replaces disconnected tools—sales, finance, HR, projects, communications, documents, service and analytics - on a single data model. Built-in automation runs across every module out of the box, removing connectors and integration fees while costing less than typical SaaS stacks.
